title: Query-Aware Flow Diffusion for Graph-Based RAG with Retrieval Guarantees
authors: Zhuoping Zhou; Davoud Ataee Tarzanagh; Sima Didari; Wenjun Hu; Baruch Gutow; Oxana Verkholyak; Masoud Faraki; Heng Hao; Hankyu Moon; Seungjai Min
why_relevant: Proposes a graph-based RAG retrieval method with theoretical recovery guarantees that suppresses irrelevant nodes, tangentially related to noisy retrieval mitigation.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on improving graph traversal quality for multi-hop QA, not on robustness to adversarial, conflicting, or unreliable evidence per se.
